summary: Two measured one-line fixes handed over by W1-30B and W1-30F, each falling in the other's file. (1) province.js cast/receive flags so the region vistas can contain a shadow at all. (2) renderer.js regionFog carries fog.height_falloff_m so sky.js's colour-keyed fallback table can be retired.
notes: province.js flag edits are narrow (castShadow/receiveShadow only). renderer.js edit is one added property on the regionFog literal. sky.js edit is the deletion the file's own comment asks for once that property exists.
